title: REINDEER AND CARIBOU ARE THE SAME ANIMAL
caption: Caribou or reindeer? Two names, one species. 🦌 #Reindeer #Caribou #Wildlife #WildVox

narration_timeline.text: Is this a caribou or a reindeer? Surprisingly, both names describe the same species.
narration_timeline.scene: Real North American caribou from Alaska original seconds 29–36, visibly closer animal, followed by distinct second caribou source; no zoo claim.

narration_timeline.text: Across North America, wild northern herds are usually called caribou.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic caribou in Mount Robson Park, Canada.

narration_timeline.text: In Europe and Asia, the name reindeer is more common, even when animals roam freely.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic reindeer from Finland and Svalbard; separate regions, no fake continuous migration.

narration_timeline.text: Both have broad hooves and coats suited to cold northern conditions.
narration_timeline.scene: Svalbard reindeer walking; no false close-up hoof demonstration.

narration_timeline.text: Some reindeer also live under human care, but they still belong to that same species.
narration_timeline.scene: Clearly captive reindeer at Ljubljana Zoo, Slovenia.

narration_timeline.text: Different names and settings, one remarkable northern deer: Rangifer tarandus.
narration_timeline.scene: Second separate real reindeer zoo video; avoid implying same herd as North American caribou.
